function.name: inspect_target
function.description:
Inspect a teacher-forced forward pass without changing activations.

        Request fields: texts, layers, positions, kinds, token_ids and
        compare_base. Select at most four layers and four sequences per call.

texts.description: Literal teacher-forced texts, including continuations. With compare_base=true, supply at most two texts.
texts.title: Texts

layers.description: Zero-based integer layer indices, such as [0, 3]. These are layer numbers, not tensor names.
layers.title: Layers

positions.description: Zero-based token positions including BOS. Every position must exist in every supplied text.
positions.title: Positions

kinds.description: Read-only quantities to return. Embedding rows are available through read_weights.
kinds.title: Kinds

token_ids.description: Vocabulary IDs for probabilities, which predict the next token after each selected position.
token_ids.title: Token Ids

compare_base.description: Inspect both pristine and edited weights; each text then uses two sequence evaluations.
compare_base.title: Compare Base

function.name: read_weights
function.description:
Read tensor metadata, selected slices or fixed numerical summaries.

        Request fields: tensor, selection, summary and handle. Handles refer to
        bounded numeric arrays held by this session's service.

tensor.description: Exact tensor name or tied alias from the manifest. Omit tensor and handle for the manifest.
tensor.title: Tensor

selection.description: One integer or [start, stop] half-open range per dimension. Example for a row of a matrix with width 4: [2, [0, 4]]. Omit for the whole tensor.
selection.title: Selection

summary.description: Return the fixed numerical summary instead of a numeric-array handle.
summary.title: Summary

handle.description: Session-held numeric array ID from a previous read or inspection. Use either tensor or handle.
handle.title: Handle

function.name: run_target
function.description:
Generate for public or editor-supplied prompts under the shared budget.

        Request fields: prompts, max_new_tokens and compare_base. At most eight
        sequences per call. Base and edited evaluations count separately.

prompts.description: Public or editor-supplied text prompts. With compare_base=true, supply at most four prompts.
prompts.title: Prompts

compare_base.description: Evaluate both pristine and edited weights; each prompt then uses two sequence evaluations.
compare_base.title: Compare Base

function.name: write_weights
function.description:
Apply an explicit replacement, fill, scale, copy or low-rank addition.

        Request fields: tensor, selection, operation, value, source, factor,
        left and right. Numeric expressions are bounded declarative operations.

tensor.description: Exact writable tensor name or tied alias from the manifest.
tensor.title: Tensor

selection.description: One integer or [start, stop] range per dimension. A matrix row requires both dimensions, for example [2, [0, 4]]. Omit for the whole tensor.
selection.title: Selection

anyOf.description: Bounded tensor expression: {tensor: NAME, selection: [...]}, {handle: ID}, {values: numeric_array}, or {op: add|subtract|outer|scale, left: expression, right: expression, factor: number}. Outer requires vectors; scale uses factor.

value.description: Finite scalar for fill; tensor expression for replace or add. Shapes must match the selected destination.
value.title: Value

anyOf.description: Bounded tensor expression: {tensor: NAME, selection: [...]}, {handle: ID}, {values: numeric_array}, or {op: add|subtract|outer|scale, left: expression, right: expression, factor: number}. Outer requires vectors; scale uses factor.

source.description: Source expression for copy, such as {tensor: NAME, selection: [2, [0, 4]]}.
source.title: Source

factor.description: Finite scale factor for scale or low_rank_add.
factor.title: Factor

anyOf.description: Bounded tensor expression: {tensor: NAME, selection: [...]}, {handle: ID}, {values: numeric_array}, or {op: add|subtract|outer|scale, left: expression, right: expression, factor: number}. Outer requires vectors; scale uses factor.

left.description: Left [m, r] expression for low_rank_add; r is at most 8.
left.title: Left

anyOf.description: Bounded tensor expression: {tensor: NAME, selection: [...]}, {handle: ID}, {values: numeric_array}, or {op: add|subtract|outer|scale, left: expression, right: expression, factor: number}. Outer requires vectors; scale uses factor.

right.description: Right [r, n] expression for low_rank_add; destination shape is [m, n].
right.title: Right
